title: RS Corridor Flood Watch: flood-potential thresholds (EDI, API) for the BR-116, BR-386 and BR-290 corridors, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
description: Independent study that calibrates and validates, out of sample and against S2iD municipal flood records, flood-potential thresholds based on the Effective Drought Index (EDI) and the Antecedent Precipitation Index (API) computed on upstream-basin MERGE rainfall, and applies the frozen rules to ECMWF and GFS forecasts. Pre-registered protocol (docs/protocol.md), decision log and negative results included. Derived study tables are in data/processed/study; raw data belong to their providers (docs/data-sources.md). Not an official warning.
notes: Data providers: MERGE/CPTEC-INPE, Atlas Digital de Desastres no Brasil (MIDR/CEPED-UFSC), ANA, IBGE, DNIT, PRF, Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), ECMWF open data (CC BY 4.0), NOAA GFS.
